item.title: Structured validator verdict format with per-AC results
item.intent: The validator must output structured per-AC pass/fail results so the orchestrator can build targeted retry context that tells the developer exactly which acceptance criteria failed and where.
item.description: The validator currently outputs free-text reason on failure. Change the validator prompt to require structured JSON with ac_results array. Update the orchestrator to parse ac_results and build per-AC retry context. Fall back to current format if structured parsing fails.
steps: In agents/validator.md, update the output format section to require structured JSON with ac_results array
Define the schema: each ac_result has ac_index, met boolean, issue string, file string optional, line int optional
In aishore _run_validation_cycle, after reading result.json, attempt to parse ac_results with jq
If ac_results exists, build targeted retry context listing only failed ACs with their issue and file:line
If ac_results parsing fails, fall back to existing behavior using reason field as-is
Update _build_prior_failure_context to format per-AC failures when structured data is available
acceptanceCriteria: Validator agent outputs result.json with ac_results array containing per-AC pass/fail verdicts
On retry, developer receives targeted context listing only the specific ACs that failed with file:line references
If validator outputs old-format result.json without ac_results, orchestrator falls back to existing behavior without error
shellcheck passes with zero new warnings
